scripts.check: pnpm run fmt:check && oxlint scripts && pnpm run lint:markdown && pnpm run check:workflows && pnpm run check:preflight && pnpm -r --if-present run check && knip && pnpm run knip:production
scripts.lint: oxlint scripts && pnpm run lint:markdown && pnpm -r --if-present run lint
scripts.fmt: oxfmt package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml knip.json lint-staged.config.mjs scripts/check-workflows.mjs .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml knip.json lint-staged.config.mjs scripts/check-workflows.mjs .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc --check
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist apps/*/dist-electron packages/*/dist .turbo apps/*/.turbo packages/*/.turbo
